all_support_claims_verified.description: Review flag; false also includes claims not fully reviewed.

unresolved_evidence_candidates.description: Number of associated evidence candidates whose support was insufficient to add them to the relation.

historical_context_flagged.description: The relation involves a historical event; do not assume it describes the current situation.

independence_verified.description: Whether source independence was established, not assumed.

time_or_scope_review_required.description: True when a retained review flag requires time/scope interpretation.
